events.title: Discovery Days Art
events.description:
·

Ages 2–6 with an adult

$2.50 per person members, $2.75 per person non-members
Fees are collected for all people ages 2 and up

Discovery Days is an early childhood program for children ages 2 to 6 and their caregivers to have fun together with educational, hands-on art, music, and movement activities. When you attend Discovery Days with your child, you will help them cultivate important school-readiness skills, such as language development, attention, concentration, fine motor skills, emotional regulation, and play and social abilities.

Attend a session that fits your schedule—no registration needed. Maximum attendance per session is 40 people (adults & children); please arrive a few minutes before the start time to get into the class.

events.title: Craft Storytime
events.description:
·
  • For ages 3-5
  • Library Meeting Rooms
  • No registration required
  • This program is in English

 

Enjoy stories, songs, movement, and a hands-on craft while building social-emotional, early literacy, and fine motor skills. Craft storytime is open for all ages, but the crafting portion is best for preschoolers.

 

All storytimes require a dedicated adult caregiver remain in the storytime room, caregiver interaction during storytime is essential for children’s abilities to learn and grow.

 

This program is generously supported by the Friends of the Longmont Library.

events.title: Spanish-English Conversation Group
events.description:
·
  • Unquiet Study Area, upstairs
  • No registration required
  • This program is presented in English and Spanish

Practice Spanish or English conversation with others in an informal, conversational setting. We recommend attendees have at least an intermediate level of Spanish to effectively participate, but everyone is welcome! Conversations are guided by Library staff and volunteers.

events.title: Make it Better
events.description:
·

The world can be a cruel place, right? So what are you willing to do to Make It Better? In this weekly club, we cheer up the depressed and lonely, improve our natural environment, run kindness campaigns, and spread happiness to those around us!

 

  • The Zone opens: 3 pm
  • Snack: 3-4 pm
  • Activities: 4-5 pm
  • Drop-in time: 5-5:30 pm

 

We offer a small lunch/snack every day. Please bring your own water bottle.

 

Questions? Call 303-651-8580 or email CYandF@longmontcolorado.gov

events.title: Art & Sip: Woven Watercolors
events.description:
·

Two sessions: 4 – 6 pm AND 6:30 – 8:30 pm

Instructor: Julie Benoit

 

Grab a drink and get creative with these classes designed to guide beginners as well as bring new skills to experienced artists and crafters. Wine, beer, fizzy water and snacks are available to purchase.

 

Discover a playful fusion of watercolor painting and paper craft in this creative paper weaving class. Begin by exploring watercolor techniques, blending colors, creating textures and experimenting with patterns to design your own painted papers. Then, carefully cut and weave them together to form a finished art piece.
